title: Exploring internal stickiness: Impediments to the transfer of best practice within the firm
formatted_reference: Szulanski, G. Exploring internal stickiness: Impediments to the transfer of best practice within the firm. Strategic Management Journal 17(S2), 27–43 (1996).
read_level: Original article PDF, abstract and transfer-process/conceptual sections, printed pp.27–30; publisher metadata matched on 2026-11-08
support: Knowledge transfer problems relate to recipient absorptive capacity, causal ambiguity and source-recipient relations; transfer as a process rather than mere diffusion.
boundary: Observational best-practice transfers in established firms, predates generative AI; no experimental causal identification of the proposed handover design.

title: Deliberate Learning and the Evolution of Dynamic Capabilities
